name: cloudpilot-monorepo
description: CloudPilot - AI-Powered Cloud Deployment & Observability Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=packages/shared && npm run type-check --workspace=apps/api && npm run type-check --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web --if-present && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api --if-present
